proposals.reason: First dedicated guidance on clinical evidence requirements for orphan IVDs under IVDR, filling regulatory gap for low-volume devices.

card.t: MDCG 2026-6: Orphan IVD Clinical Evidence Guidance
card.x: First guidance on clinical evidence for orphan in vitro diagnostic devices under IVDR, addressing challenges for low-volume market products.

proposals.reason: Consultation closed, indefinite CE recognition confirmed on 21 Oct 2026, removing previous uncertainty and transition deadlines.

card.t: MHRA Indefinite CE Mark Recognition — Confirmed
card.x: CE-marked devices may be placed on GB market indefinitely without mandatory UKCA transition. Removes previous uncertainty; ~90% of GB devices are CE-marked.

proposals.reason: ENISA alert on active cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems including healthcare cold chains; CRA reporting obligations in force since 11 Sep 2026.

card.x: Joint alert on attacks targeting connected refrigeration systems including healthcare cold chains. CRA vulnerability reporting obligations apply since 11 Sep 2026.

proposals.reason: FDA qualifies Apple Watch AFib History as secondary efficacy endpoint for cardiac ablation device trials, enabling new trial pathway.

card.t: FDA Qualifies Apple Watch AFib History for Clinical Trials
card.x: Atrial Fibrillation History feature qualified as secondary efficacy endpoint for cardiac ablation device trials. Distinct from general clinical use authorization.

proposals.reason: New comprehensive MHRA guidance covering all key steps for SaMD market placement in UK, including classification and conformity pathways.

card.t: MHRA SaMD Placing on Market Guidance
card.x: Comprehensive guidance covering device determination, classification, conformity pathways, marking, standards, clinical investigations and registration for SaMD in UK.
